title: 词汇打假现场：sceneries 不是"情况"
takeaway: I'm not much of a shopping person—off the top of my head, I shop online maybe twice a year.

lines: a
Bruce，欢迎回到词汇打假现场。今天要打的第一假，是你口语里出镜率最高的假货，sceneries。你几乎所有想说"情况、场景"的地方都用了它：in some specific sceneries，different sceneries。但 scenery 在英语里只有一个意思：自然风景。山、湖、公园里的景色。你真正想说的"情况"，是 situation，或者 scenario。听母语者示范：
b
It really depends on the situation. In that kind of scenario, I'd just walk away.
a
situation，scenario。下次想说"在某些特定情况下"，就说 in certain situations。好，第二个假货，你聊演唱会的时候找不到词，卡在了那里：it's a sport museum, I can say it's not museum... it's just a very huge place。Bruce，那个词四秒就能说完：
b
Stadium. I watched my first live show in a huge stadium, and the vibe was unreal.
a
Stadium，体育场。顺便，看演唱会是 live show，现场。你以前说的是 life show，那是人生秀。还有三个假货，快速清仓。第一，你聊手表说 know what carry I actually spend——你想说的是卡路里，calories：
b
My watch tells me how many calories I've burned.
a
第二，你想说死海，说的是 dead lake。它有名字：the Dead Sea。第三，你两次想表达"我不是爱逛街的人"，说的是 I'm not kind of shopping person。就差一步！正确的说法是今天第一个特写语块：
b
I'm not much of a shopping person.
a
Not much of a，算不上是某种人。这个框架能套住你整个人设：I'm not much of a city person. I'm not much of a morning person. I'm not much of a car person. 一句话，人格立住了。第二个特写语块，专治卡壳。下次考官问了道你一时想不出答案的题，别 um um um，体面地买五秒钟：
b
Off the top of my head, I'd say...
a
不加思索地讲。考官听到这句反而觉得你流利。现在实战。考官问你真实聊过的题，先听母语者打样：
a
Do you like going to parks? Would you like to see more parks in your city?
b

To be honest, I'm not much of an outdoorsy person—I grew up glued to video games. But these days I've really come around, because going to a park gives me a sense of peace. I like watching people, the scenery, the animals—it's a nice break from screens. Off the top of my head, I'd say my city could always use more parks. A lot of them are pretty far from where I live, so if there were more green spaces nearby, I'd definitely go more often.
a
数一数：not much of an outdoorsy person，off the top of my head，还有真正的 scenery——这次是真的风景。你的内容，母语者的料。好，八秒实战。用 not much of a 或者 off the top of my head，回答这道题：Do you like shopping? 必须出声。预备——
a
收工。今天的带走句，闭眼听三遍。
b
I'm not much of a shopping person—off the top of my head, I shop online maybe twice a year.
a
明天，Part 3 观点题军火库开库。Bruce，今天打得漂亮。
